title: Whistleblower Reward & Anti-Fraud Statutory Framework
platform_rule: Any OSINT audit or taxpayer disclosure that halts fraud, recovers tax dollars, or unmasks illegal contracts triggers mandatory statutory payout rights under state and federal law.

statutes.statute_citation: California False Claims Act (Cal. Gov. Code § 12650 et seq.)
statutes.whistleblower_payout_rate: 15% to 33% of Total Recovered Public Funds
statutes.statutory_protection: Cal. Gov. Code § 12653 (Protection against retaliation, threat, or discrimination)

statutes.statute_citation: Federal False Claims Act (31 U.S.C. § 3730 - Qui Tam Action)
statutes.whistleblower_payout_rate: 15% to 30% of Total Damages & Penalties Recovered
statutes.statutory_protection: 31 U.S.C. § 3730(h) (Federal Whistleblower Relief & Mandatory Triple Damages)

statutes.whistleblower_payout_rate: 15% to 30% of Taxes, Penalties, & Interest Collected

statutes.statute_citation: SEC Whistleblower Program (15 U.S.C. § 78u-6 - Dodd-Frank Act)
statutes.category: Corporate Disclosure Fraud & Real Estate Trust Deception
